description: Add one subscriber. Status is only applied when creating a new contact; use update_subscriber to change an existing contact's status. The subscribers:write scope covers listIds in this call. Matching sequences enroll by default (REST enrollInSequences), including tag_added when tags are set in this call, without requiring a list; pass enrollInSequences false to skip, and automations:trigger is required for enrollment. Without automations:trigger the call succeeds but starts no sequence (sequenceTriggersRan false, reason missing_scope). For multiple contacts or CRM records, use create_subscriber_import instead of looping this tool. For an email-only batch going into one list, add_subscribers_to_list is also available.

attributes.description: Custom attributes (plan, company, etc.). Same field as REST customAttributes; provide one or the other. Use firstName/lastName for names instead of attributes. Values keep their JSON types, so send zip codes and IDs with leading zeros as strings; call list_subscriber_attributes to reuse existing names and types.

companyId.description: Company ID to add subscriber to. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

createdAt.description: Original signup date (ISO 8601) when importing a contact from another platform. Preserves their real history so date-relative segments like 'added in the last 30 days' are correct immediately instead of treating every imported contact as brand new. An existing contact's date only ever moves earlier. Supplying this defaults sequence enrollment to false. New-subscriber account notifications remain eligible when the signup date is at most one hour old; older dates do not notify on creation. Double opt-in confirmation can notify even for imported contacts. Your notification preferences, double opt-in and the daily cap still apply.

customAttributes.description: REST name for attributes. Same custom-attribute map; provide attributes or customAttributes, not both.

email.description: Subscriber email address. Optional when phone is provided - a contact created with only a phone becomes a phone-only (SMS) contact.

enrollInSequences.description: Whether matching sequences may enroll this contact, including tag_added flows when tags are set in the same call. Same field as REST POST /api/v1/subscribers enrollInSequences. Defaults to true unless createdAt is supplied. Requires automations:trigger. Pass false to create and tag without enrollment. List membership is not required.

externalId.description: Customer-owned subscriber ID. Provide this with email when creating, or instead of email for an existing subscriber.

firstName.description: Subscriber first name, stored as a native profile field.

lastName.description: Subscriber last name, stored as a native profile field.

listIds.description: List IDs to add subscriber to, covered by subscribers:write. Omit to let a contact this call creates follow the workspace default lists; an existing contact then keeps the memberships they already have. Pass [] to join no list.

optInMode.description: Consent mode: confirmed creates active immediately when consent is verified, double_opt_in sends a confirmation email before activation, and default obeys company double opt-in settings.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 or national format, stored as a native profile field. With no email, creates or matches a phone-only (SMS) contact.

phoneCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used to read a national-format phone number, such as IT or US. Defaults to US. Only send it together with phone; the stored country always comes from the parsed number.

smsConsent.description: Set true only when express written SMS marketing consent was verified for this phone number. Never inferred from phone presence.

status.description: Initial subscriber status: active, unsubscribed, or bounced. Defaults to active and does not change an existing contact; use update_subscriber for existing contacts.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the subscriber

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. America/New_York), stored as a native profile field. Enables recipient-local campaign delivery for this contact.

name: add_subscriber

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `add_subscriber` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequenceTriggersRan.description: False when no sequence could start from this call (see sequenceTriggersSkippedReason).

sequenceTriggersSkippedReason.description: missing_scope: key lacks automations:trigger (write still applied). not_requested: enrollInSequences false. historical: recorded as history.

subscriber.description: The subscriber record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
